pre_condition: value is any input; str(value) produces a string without raising an exception.
post_condition: Returns a string. The returned string has no leading or trailing whitespace characters and no trailing semicolon characters (';'). When the non-whitespace portion of the intermediate result is at least two characters long and both its first and last characters are the same single-quote (') or double-quote (") character, those surrounding quote characters are removed. Returns the empty string when the final content has no non-whitespace characters.
